description: The TIGER/Line Shapefiles are extracts from the Census Bureau's MAF/TIGER database. Among their layers are transport features: primary roads (MAF/TIGER feature class S1100) as a national file, primary and secondary roads (S1100 and S1200) by state, all roads by county, and rail lines, together with address range features that link street segments to addresses. The core files carry no demographic data but contain geographic entity codes that link to Census Bureau statistics. Coverage is national for the United States. The shapefiles are free, available to download through a web interface and an FTP archive for each year from 2007 to the present, with ASCII TIGER/Line files for 2006 and earlier; the 2025 edition was released on 23 September 2025 with legal boundaries as of 1 January 2025, and copies (such as a Harvard Dataverse deposit of the primary and secondary roads) circulate. Caveats: TIGER is built for census operations, so it has no lanes, speeds, surfaces or traffic. The road and rail centrelines, joined to census geography, support accessibility, evacuation and exposure analyses that combine population with transport networks. They complement the National Highway System and other federal transport network data and are related to OpenStreetMap.
